Welcome to our website for information on entrance examinations.
This website shows the necessary information on GSFS entrance examinations.
[Important] For those who are applying
NOTICE: Graduate School of Frontier Sciences, The University of Tokyo (hereinafter referred to as “the Graduate School”) has no partnerships, affiliations, or cooperative relationships with any private agents, consultants, or individuals regarding admissions selection or scholarship recommendations.
The Graduate School does not authorize any individuals or organizations to provide paid admissions or application support on its behalf.
Accordingly, the Graduate School assumes no responsibility for any problems, disputes, or disadvantages that may arise from the use of such unauthorized services.
Please ensure that all application preparations are made strictly in accordance with the guidelines published on the official Graduate School website. Please also be aware that some unauthorized agents may be involved in fraudulent or illegal practices. (December 26, 2025)
・Applications must be submitted online. Please make sure that you can receive emails from the [ @e-apply.jp ] domain sent from the online application site.
・This graduate school does not send the Examination Admission Ticket, Notification of Acceptance, Notification of Admission, or Admission Procedure Documents by mail. When these documents become available for download, a "printable notification" email will be sent from the Online Application Site (e-apply). Please log in to your My Page and download them yourself. For the specific download periods, please check the Application Guidelines. ※ Only eligible applicants can download these documents from their My Page.
・If you have any questions, please check "6. FAQs" at the bottom of this page.
・The Guidelines for Applicants to the 2027 [Master's and doctoral programs] have been released. (March 23, 2026)
・In case of natural disasters or other uncontrollable events, the schedule and method of examination are subject to change. Please check the GSFS website for the latest information.
For examinations administered by individual departments, announcements will be made on each department's website. Applicants are advised to check both the GSFS "Information on Entrance Examinations" page and the website of the department to which they are applying.

2-4. Online Application Site / The Online Application Flow
IMPORTANT NOTICE:[For Those Planning to Apply for the 2027 Schedule B Entrance Examinations] Due to system maintenance, all functions of the online application system will be unavailable from 1:00 a.m. to 6:00 a.m. (Japan Standard Time) on November 17, 2026.
Please avoid submitting your application close to the deadline and complete your online application well in advance.
[For Prospective AY2027 Applicants] My Page Registration will be available from 9:00 a.m. on April 14, 2026.
[For AY2026 Successful Applicants] The Notification of Acceptance and/or Notification of Admission will be available for download from your "My Page" starting from 10:00 AM on February 12, 2026, until March 15, 2026. Please be sure to download them in time, as you will no longer be able to log in to your My Page from March 16, 2026.
